# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.2.0

Version 1.2.0 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.1.2

- **The host's furniture, live.** When the host places, moves, turns or removes furniture in a house, or changes the
  wallpaper or carpet, guests see it at once. A guest standing in that room sees the furniture rebuilt where it stands
  (when it is not in a menu or a conversation). Before, guests saw the house as it was when they received the town.
  Not shared: what is inside storage furniture, and lamps on or off. As in the original game, nobody can move the
  furniture of someone else's house.
- **Villagers follow the host's.** Villagers wandering near the host walk or run to the same places on guests' screens,
  with their walking animation; villagers away from the host are in the same acres; and they go home, come out and
  sleep when the host's do. Talking to or greeting a villager is still your own: during a conversation it stands still
  on your screen and follows again afterwards. Villagers inside houses, the island villager, insects and fish still
  move on each machine by themselves.
- **Guests now see the host's house** (and villagers' houses) where the host had been: a building's placeholder in the
  map was copied to guests, so their game thought the building was already there and did not show it.
- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog).
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- **Everyone in a room needs this version** (the host and the guests).

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- How to play multiplayer and what to keep in mind: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer).

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.2.0-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.2.0-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.2.0-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.2.0-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a) |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

- Two copies of the game (Linux) with two saved towns, the guest in the host's town:
  - furniture: the guest walks into the host's house and stands there; the host comes in and places a chest from its
    pockets; the chest appears on the guest's screen, in the same place, without the guest leaving the room;
  - the host's house is there on the guest's screen (it was missing before), and the guest can go in;
  - villagers: both players stand in an acre with two villagers; on the guest both follow the host's, usually 5 to 40
    units apart (about 100 at most while running; a unit of ground is 40), on the same schedule.
- All unit tests pass. The decomp changes are inside `TARGET_PC` only; the matching build gives the same hashes.
- Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.2.0, versionCode 10200).

## Known limitations

- Only the villagers in the host's acre have an exact position; elsewhere they are in the same acres but move on each
  machine by themselves. Villagers inside houses are not shared.
- What is inside storage furniture, and lamps on or off, are not shared.
- Multiplayer between two real, different networks and on real Android devices has not been tried much.

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
